markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: The 2028 presidential contest features a wide-open field with no dominant frontrunner, as reflected in trader consensus showing JD Vance at the top followed closely by Marco Rubio and a mix of Democratic and Republican names. Early-cycle dynamics, including post-2024 party positioning, potential primary challenges, and the influence of swing-state polling trends, keep probabilities fragmented. Midterm outcomes, candidate declarations, and shifts in key voting blocs could create separation, while historical patterns of incumbent-party advantages and late developments like scandals or endorsements remain key variables that markets continue to price in.
